answer.justification: Only activation measurements were available, and they match the quantized range closely. Relative L2 is 0.096 at layer 1, 0.184 at layer 8, 0.194 at layer 16, 0.205 at layer 24 and 0.255 at layer 32, a flat plateau with a late onset at layer 11. Final cosine is 0.966, effective rank 4.09 (noise-like), direction consistency 0.514 and mid-layer size ratio 0.968 (shrinking). The 0.968 ratio and the 0.514 consistency match quantized almost exactly. Fine-tuned would show a size ratio above 1, lower rank and higher consistency. System-prompted would show a large layer-2 spike, a layer-16 L2 of 0.37 or more and an onset at layer 7-8. Base is ruled out because the differences are non-zero.
